# h24_two_scenarios

Report issues: D2.

**Source.** Hand-made SimOxide corpus model (`corpus/h24_two_scenarios`, generated by refsim's `HandMade.java`). Licence: EPL-2.0 (SimOxide repository). `run.json` and `FEATURES.txt` are SimOxide metadata (`run.json` holds SimuLizar stop conditions; Slingshot uses the simulation time below).

## Model

Two usage scenarios (one open, one closed) share one FCFS CPU; random demands.

## Run with stock Slingshot

Import the folder into an Eclipse workspace with the Slingshot nightly. Create a *Slingshot Simulation* run configuration:

- Allocation Model: `h24_two_scenarios.allocation`
- Usage Model: `h24_two_scenarios.usagemodel`
- Monitor Repository: `h24_two_scenarios.monitorrepository`
- Simulation tab: maximum simulation time **16 s**; EDP2, an in-memory repository.

The other model files are loaded through the references. Set the console log level to INFO to see the dispatched events and the handler errors (`An error occurred: …`).

The model draws random numbers. Stock Slingshot cannot be seeded, so times and values vary between runs; the effect described below does not depend on them.

## What to look for

- Run it several times with the same seed (needs the seeding of the reference runner, see the report's appendix). The measurements differ between runs.
- Observed with `--stock -seed 23 -runs 3` (one JVM) and one more fresh JVM: the first two runs of the JVM differ; usage-scenario 2 mean response time 0.1065 vs 0.1156; scenario 1 has 47 vs 46 rows. The order in which the two scenarios' users start at t = 0 decides which user receives which drawn demand.

## Expected

The same inputs (and seed) give the same results; same-time order is deterministic.

## Observed (reference runner)

`observed/` holds the outputs of the SimOxide reference runner, deterministic mode, `-seed 23 -simTime 16` (appendix of `../../REPORT.md`): .
`errors.txt` lists the handler exceptions (`exception: message | first Slingshot frame`), one per disposed handler; `measurements.csv` the EDP2 rows (`measuring_point,metric,time,value`); `projection*.jsonl` the dispatched model-level events (users, calls, jobs, measurements, SPD events; `projection-m.jsonl` without passed elements and jobs).

Headless (optional, from `reference/slingshot/`):

```sh
./run.sh --stock -model upstream-report/reproductions/h24_two_scenarios -out /tmp/h24_two_scenarios -simTime 16 -seed 1
./run.sh         -model upstream-report/reproductions/h24_two_scenarios -out /tmp/h24_two_scenarios-det -simTime 16 -seed 23   # deterministic
```
